description: Settlement date for a trade date: US equities T+1 on NYSE and Federal Reserve days, or T+n on a caller calendar — Computes the settlement date for a trade date under US equities T+1 (17 CFR 240.15c6-1, compliance date 2024-05-28) counting only days when the NYSE and the Federal Reserve Banks are open, or T+n on a named or caller calendar, and checks an asserted settlement date. The settlement-day rule (NYSE and Reserve Banks both open, so Columbus Day and Veterans Day are skipped) is our inference, not a publ

calendar.description: Named holiday calendar with a source and supported date range (outside it the answer is unsupported), weekends-only (Saturday/Sunday only), or caller (only the holidays you list).

holidays.description: Extra non-business dates YYYY-MM-DD (company closures, a calendar we do not carry).

settlement.description: us-equities: T+1 since 2024-05-28 on the us-equities-settlement calendar (2026-2028). custom: cycleDays on calendar/holidays/weekend.

weekend.description: Non-business weekdays, 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Default [0, 6]; use [5, 6] for a Friday/Saturday weekend.

name: settlement-date
